INSERT INTO TEAM_MEMBER ( TEAM_MEMBER_NUM, TEAM_NUM, USER_NUM, ROLE, JOIN_STATUS, JOINED_AT ) VALUES ( #{team_member_num}, #{team_num}, #{user_num}, #{role}, 1, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT TM.TEAM_MEMBER_NUM, TM.TEAM_NUM, TM.USER_NUM, TM.ROLE, TM.JOIN_STATUS, TM.JOINED_AT, TM.LAST_ACTIVITY_AT, TM.EXITED_AT, U.USER_NAME, U.EMAIL, U.INTRO, U.PHOTO_NAME FROM TEAM_MEMBER TM JOIN USERS U ON TM.USER_NUM = U.USER_NUM WHERE TM.TEAM_NUM = #{teamNum} AND TM.USER_NUM = #{userNum} AND TM.JOIN_STATUS = 1

SELECT TM.TEAM_MEMBER_NUM, TM.TEAM_NUM, TM.USER_NUM, TM.ROLE, TM.JOIN_STATUS, TM.JOINED_AT, TM.LAST_ACTIVITY_AT, U.USER_NAME, U.EMAIL, U.INTRO, U.PHOTO_NAME FROM TEAM_MEMBER TM JOIN USERS U ON TM.USER_NUM = U.USER_NUM WHERE TM.TEAM_NUM = #{teamNum} AND TM.JOIN_STATUS = 1 ORDER BY TM.ROLE DESC, TM.JOINED_AT ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TEAM_MEMBER WHERE TEAM_NUM = #{teamNum} AND JOIN_STATUS = 1

SELECT T.TEAM_NUM, T.TEAM_NAME, T.DESCRIPTION, T.TEAM_PHOTO, T.TEAM_PHOTO_NAME, T.COLOR, T.STATUS, T.CREATED_AT, T.UPDATED_AT, T.CREATOR_NUM FROM TEAM T JOIN TEAM_MEMBER TM ON T.TEAM_NUM = TM.TEAM_NUM WHERE TM.USER_NUM = #{userNum} AND TM.JOIN_STATUS = 1 AND T.STATUS != 3 ORDER BY TM.JOINED_AT DESC
